shared_setup: For each member and admin run, first obtain the stabilization resource permit and receipt required by docs/stabilization/PLAN.md: exact source/build/output identity, loaded extension ID and version, Chrome version, disposable profile, role/org, permission state, and timestamp. Do not retain credentials or arbitrary prompt/response text in the evidence.

Use a current receipt-bound unpacked build. Verify the loaded extension against the receipt, reload the extension, reopen its side panel, and refresh any controlled target tab. Execute a warm pass and a separate post-reload pass for each role, each with its own run evidence. HMR or manifest version alone is insufficient.

In the signed-in side panel open Tools > Catalog. Change the surface selector from Agent surface to Internal delegates (or All handlers); search the exact ai_* name, expand its row, replace sample JSON with the stated args, press Run, and inspect the inline result. Run calls the local handler directly and bypasses the dispatcher permission gate.

Use only synthetic text or image inputs entered manually; do not sample private page data. Before each capability test run ai_check_availability with {} in the same loaded build and record its reported capability state. A dedicated API may succeed despite languageModel absence; summarize, translate, and proofread can fall back to languageModel. Capability report is service-worker-local and is evidence, not a promise of execution.

All nine tools are tier read and list no required Chrome or optional permissions. Guest stays not applicable to this direct Tools route because the Tools tab requires sign-in. The manual route cannot verify Ask/Act denial, role-specific dispatcher gating, DB tool.definition/tool.binding presence, or agent advertisement.
source_drift: Inventory calls the nine named tools registered executor entries with agent surface bundles. Current code registers them as local handlers, but the default Tools Agent surface contains canonical ai, while ai_* are Internal delegates; exact-name DB definition and extension binding were absent in the recorded 2026-10-04 census. Test the named controls through Internal delegates. Do not infer live agent reachability from these procedures.

src/lib/onbox-ai/client.ts introduction describes a MAIN-world fallback, but quickPrompt/getAi shown here operate on globals in the current service-worker context. The procedures do not assume a tab fallback exists.
